scope: Public interface references; no runtime connection or admission claims

interfaces.name: ChatGPT
interfaces.purpose: Use the existing Starlight cloud plugin from a connected host.
interfaces.boundary: Host installation and authorization are separate from this catalog.

interfaces.name: OpenAI Agents API
interfaces.purpose: Managed Codex harness for cloud or self-hosted environments.
interfaces.boundary: Requires project credentials, environment policy and beta admission.

interfaces.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
interfaces.interface: Agent / Runner with handoffs and tracing
interfaces.purpose: Build an application-owned loop when a native harness is insufficient.
interfaces.boundary: Do not add a second Starlight router; use an admitted worker adapter.

interfaces.name: Codex
interfaces.sdk: Codex SDK or App Server client
interfaces.purpose: Drive local work with native approval and progress events.
interfaces.boundary: Needs an authenticated worker on the machine holding the checkout.

interfaces.name: Claude Code
interfaces.sdk: Claude Agent SDK for application-owned workers
interfaces.purpose: Review a pinned change through the existing GitHub workflow or a bound worker.
interfaces.boundary: A GitHub review does not connect private Claude chats or your laptop.

interfaces.name: Google ADK
interfaces.interface: ADK agents; A2A Agent Card and tasks
interfaces.purpose: Expose an admitted remote specialist through negotiated A2A capabilities.
interfaces.boundary: ADK is a framework; A2A is the inter-agent protocol, not model API equivalence.

interfaces.name: OpenCode
interfaces.purpose: Use one native worker session under Queen's existing assignment policy.
interfaces.boundary: Bind an explicit checkout and authenticated server; do not expose a local worker publicly.

interfaces.name: Hermes
interfaces.purpose: Reuse its worker lifecycle, tools, approvals and session persistence.
interfaces.boundary: Negotiate the instance's actual API and permissions before admission.

interfaces.name: OpenClaw
interfaces.purpose: Use an explicitly enabled gateway profile for an admitted worker.
interfaces.boundary: Shared-secret bearer grants full operator access; never treat it as scoped customer authorization.

interfaces.name: Paperclip
interfaces.interface: Tasks, approvals, runs and adapter metadata
interfaces.purpose: Project authorized work metadata into the existing manager view.
interfaces.boundary: Keep upstream ownership; source status does not establish verified completion.
